validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="count" expr="0"/>
    <data id="done" expr="false()"/>
    <data id="user"><name xmlns="">bob</name></data>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="go" cond="_event.data.ok" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `_event.data.ok` is one element name that contains dots, not a member access
notes: the context node of every XPath expression is `<datamodel>`, whose children are `<data id="…">` elements and the system variables; an empty node-set is false, so this condition never holds
diagnostics.help: `.` is part of an XPath name; select the child element with a path: `$_event/data/ok`
